title: The Voice of Wisdom in the Shadows
intro: A figure from ancient times, known for profound insight, speaks to you across the centuries. This individual never claimed prophethood, yet divine wisdom flowed through their words. A parent who left an eternal legacy of guidance, their advice remains preserved in the hearts of millions, recited and reflected upon to this day.
clues: I received a divine gift that set me apart - a wisdom so deep it became my defining trait throughout history.
I was not a messenger nor an angel - just a soul blessed with deep understanding and insight into the world.
My closest bond was with my child, and through this bond, my most lasting message was delivered.
I urged gratitude to the One who gave me everything, and warned against pride and arrogance.
I taught about the weight of even a mustard seed's worth of deeds, and the importance of lowering one's voice in humility.
A chapter in the Quran bears my name, where my counsel to my beloved son is preserved for all eternity.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
